result.reason: The operative redline fully achieves the preferred position by expressly eliminating exclusivity, non-compete, and sole-supplier obligations and HDI’s exclusive brand right. The fallback limitations are also satisfied because their predicate—an exclusivity obligation—is expressly absent.
